fullDaySay: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 50s telling A man, maybe 40s, with a broad frame about A person, maybe 20s. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
💧 A woman, maybe 20s returns with water: +4 clean.
"Hey." A person, maybe 20s settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 20s.)
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A woman, maybe 40s, with freckles is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 84/100)
Ruth and Laura lingered over the fire together.

You remember the Rain Shell at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
🤒 Caleb is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.
Meera sits with Caleb — cool cloth, bitter tea, watching the breathing.

Snow by morning. (0°C — Cold) The ground goes iron — forage thin, walking dear.

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
The water is cold enough to hurt your teeth. Downstream the creek bends out of sight, and you want to follow it. That's the problem with creeks.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
Movement — a bullfrog the size of a dinner plate.
👁 It sits still until you're close — then it's gone. Cover the last steps fast.
✅ You saw the creek. A woman, maybe 20s nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
You see smoke on the horizon. Thornfield — 10 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 2 plants — 2 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
You catch fragments by the fire — Greta telling David about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to grove.
— Nut trees —
The canopy here is a roof built by a thousand architects who never met. Light comes through in coins.
Movement — a great horned owl, silent and huge.
👁 It waits for YOU to come close — the stillness is the trap. Spot the shape before you're in reach, and strike first. It only gets one.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to grove.
— Nut trees —
A hollow log big enough to crawl into. You don't crawl in. You note where it is, in case the weather ever makes the offer again.
Something moves out there — the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still.
Journal: Riparian ground. Water means life, and lunch.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Green Thumb, Literally**. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.
You work the patch with practiced hands: 3× Hickory Nuts (in shell — shell them to eat). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.

1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
